_what: S22's configuration as data: what the shop's administrator sets over the record API that a manifest may not carry on the shop's own record types. apply_config.py reads this file (or PP_CONFIG). The names and amounts are the sandbox template's (Demo Retail, USD); change them to the shop's. Every name starts with PP LYL so --remove finds what it made.
